title: Week 17 Updates: Redesigned claude.ai/code Interface
description: A new look for claude.ai/code that matches the redesigned desktop app, featuring a sessions sidebar, drag-and-drop layout, and a refreshed routines view. This brings web and desktop experiences into better alignment.

title: New "xhigh" Effort Level and Claude Opus 4.7
description: Introduced a new "xhigh" effort level between "high" and "max" that is now the default recommended setting for most coding and agentic tasks. Also launched Claude Opus 4.7 as the new default on Max and Team Premium plans.

title: PR Auto-fix in CLI
description: PR Auto-fix feature is now available directly in CLI with the new /autofix-pr command that automatically infers the open PR for your current branch. Previously web-only feature now accessible from terminal.

title: Quality Update and Postmortem Report
description: Anthropic released a postmortem report addressing recent quality issues, tracing problems to three separate changes and outlining fixes to improve overall system reliability.
